# LED

Round or square LED indicator (BOOL-001, BOOL-002).

![LED, dark theme](../img/widgets/led-dark.png#only-dark){ width="56" }

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.LED(value=True, label="LED on")
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blink` | boolean | `false` | host | Blink while on (steady outline when reduced motion is requested, A11Y-005). |
| `blink_hz` | number | `2` | host | Blink frequency in Hz. |
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `off_color` | string | `""` | host | CSS color when off; empty: a dark version of on_color. |
| `on_color` | string | `"#22c55e"` | host | CSS color when lit; unsafe colors are ignored (SEC-002). |
| `shape` | `"round"`, `"square"` | `"round"` | host | LED shape (the state is also given by text for assistive technologies, A11Y-003). |
| `size` | array | `[48,48]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
